## Cost analysis

Prior live cost was memory-dominated: `score_network_v2` reported memory 29,860 + params 32 = cost 29,892. V2 removes the full `input_inner`/presence-mask path and uses direct channel-group slices; memory falls to 19,080 while params rise to 49, net cost 19,129. Reviewer correction: the 14x14 crop is not all-ones for every valid input (official examples include 10x10 and 12x12 boards with zero padding inside the crop), but the removed `in_grid` path is still redundant because the fill mask is multiplied/gated by channel 0, so padding cells have `ch0=0` and extra row/column detections outside the active board are suppressed.

## Don't-do log

- Do not resubmit the v1 relu-difference variant; it is valid but weaker than v2 by 427 cost.
- Do not repeat the over-strong claim that the 14x14 crop is always all-ones; valid smaller boards contain zero-sum padding inside the crop, and channel-0 gating is the actual safety argument.
